Jonas's teacher says he's doing great in math, which surprised me, because he told me he hates it, but apparently he finished the whole workbook two weeks early, and she's moving him up a group. In reading he's fine, but she said he talks too much, which, yes, I know, where do you think he gets it? And then she said he's been drawing in the margins of his tests, and she showed me one, and it's a really detailed drawing of a dragon eating a school bus. I know you said 11, and it was closer to midnight. That's entirely our fault. I've spoken to everyone involved, and it won't happen again. I would also like to offer to replace your flowerpot, which I'm told was knocked over by a guest. I have no idea who, but I found the pieces in the morning. Please let me know the cost, and I'd be glad to bring over a pie as well. My apple pie is quite good, if I say so myself. Again, I am truly sorry. Yours sincerely, Helen
